result.title: VOL-Agent: Programming Your Film via Video Orchestration Language Agentic System
result.summary: Recent video foundation models generate high-quality and limited-length clips, but orchestrating them into minute-level, story-coherent films remains an open problem. Existing video agents highly rely on natural-language planning or predefined workflows, which make their production hard to program, customize, and extend. Therefore, we introduce VOL-Agent, a programmable video agent built on a Video Orchestration Language (VOL). With static compilation and verification, followed by runtime dynamic loading, VOL-Agent decouples structural reliability from execution flexibility. Through the skill-driven executor, VOL-Agent dynamically resolves tools and skills from an open-world repository and supports user-defined skills in natural language. Moreover, VOL-Agent is capable of crafting new director skills from learned knowledge and improves itself through feedback to accumulate filmmaking knowledge. To overcome the disconnect between different segments, we apply a structural memory mechanism to record and recall world and entity states, sustaining entity and scene consistency across different shots. Critic feedback supports local revision, while reusable filmmaking knowledge and experiences can be retained for subsequent tasks. Experiments on three benchmarks show that VOL-Agent generates minute-scale videos with strong overall quality and limited cost.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VOL-Agent，一个基于自研视频编排语言 VOL 的可编程视频 agent，通过静态编译验证与运行时动态加载、技能驱动执行器及结构记忆机制，把短视频片段编排为分钟级、叙事连贯的影片。
AI.relevance_reason: 其显式记录世界与实体状态的结构记忆及 critic 反馈局部修订，可能为 LVR 中跨步骤保持视觉实体状态、发现状态漂移与决定重做提供概念参照，但属视频生成领域，可迁移性需核查。
